messages:
elaine-marketing: Heads-up — target publish for Release 1.4 announcement: Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 PT. Need final changelog, canonical docs links, and rollout gating details by EOD Wed. @sam-engineering @mike-docs
sam-engineering: Ack. Canary & health checks green on staging; plan is canary 09:30 PT, full traffic 11:00 PT with 15m ramp. I'll confirm capacity and fallback by EOD.
mike-docs: Draft landing page up at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/release-1.4 — still needs screenshots and PR link. Changelog trimmed below.
mike-docs: ```
Changelog — Release 1.4
- Added streaming responses for multi-turn chat
- Adaptive batching improvements (cost -12%)
- New quantization profiles for T5-family
- Bugfix: LVKV cache expiry edge-case
```
ashley-product: Webinar ask — do we want a short 15-min demo right after announce? If so, we need speaker + slides. @elaine-marketing
sam-engineering: Webinar OK if it's a soft demo (focused 15m ops overview). Speakers: Mateo or Sam. Slides: I'll drop a skeleton by tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-26T16:30:00Z (canary-id: canary-20260326-01) — health checks: cpu/latency OK. Notify #eng-oncall if any alert.
sam-engineering: One note — embeddings backend will be on a different deployment pool; if that hits limits we fallback to v0.9-embeddings which is slightly slower. Ops will ensure routing policy is set.
javier-growth: Inbound routing — wire up the announcements form to mark leads with "release_1_4" tag. I can handle mapping to HubSpot after final publish URL.
elaine-marketing: For the marketing post we need: canonical docs link, changelog excerpt (1-2 bullets), benchmark line (avg latency/cost) and webinar CTA. Can we get benchmark number?
sam-engineering: Quick bench: 95th latency (chat stream) ~ 220ms token on dedicated-2; cost per 1k tokens ~ $0.85 after batching. I'll put a short blurb you can use.
mike-docs: Final docs URL will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.4 (I'll switch redirect after merge). Screenshots ETA tomorrow 3pm PT.
elaine-marketing: Great — I'll assemble the post draft and send for sign-off by 6pm PT. If everyone can react with :thumbsup: to this thread when links/changelog/benchmarks are final, I'll lock the publish time.
sam-engineering: :thumbsup:
mike-docs: :thumbsup:
ashley-product: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-26 09:30-12:00 PT
elaine-marketing: Thanks — last call: any known risks to the timing?
sam-engineering: Only risk is a last-minute perf regression from a model patch; we have automatic fallback but will delay if SLOs degrade.
elaine-marketing: OK. If no objections by EOD Wed, we go live Thu 10:00 PT. I'll post the announcement draft in #marketing for copy review.
mike-docs: FYI PR for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
elaine-marketing: Perfect — thanks everyone.
